name: Thandiwe Nkosi
bio:
Thandiwe Nkosi’s journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for the aerodynamics of birds. This led her to pursue a degree in Aeronautical Engineering, where she excelled in fluid dynamics and design. After graduating, she joined a small racing team, quickly proving her ability to optimize airflow and downforce. Her pragmatic approach, combined with a relentless pursuit of perfection, has made her a valuable asset to any team she joins.

At Mercedes-AMG, Thandiwe leads the aerodynamics department, overseeing the design and development of the car's aerodynamic package. She believes in a data-driven approach, using wind tunnel testing and computational fluid dynamics (CFD) to identify areas for improvement. Her distinctive talent lies in her ability to translate complex technical data into practical design solutions that give her team a competitive edge. Nkosi is known for her calm, level-headed demeanor, even under the intense pressure of race weekends.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled afro with subtle grey streaks at the temples.
physical.description: Thandiwe is a woman of medium height with a strong, commanding presence, often seen wearing stylish, practical clothing.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with hand-drawn aerodynamic sketches.
Insists on calibrating the wind tunnel herself before any major test.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
